cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Payroll needs yesterday's missing hour. You get it into this jar; I'll label it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How can an hour fit through that opening?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the lid off first. Don't diagnose a capacity problem while the container's closed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've got both hands free. You catch it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the label. I need the precise recovery time. Tell me the moment you've caught it; please don't make my record approximate.

reason: Give the recovered hour an explicit purpose and make A use precise documentation to refuse B's transfer of the impossible labor.
